programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Wake-Up Call for the Nation Pt 1
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: If it oozes, aches or makes you blush, we’re talking about it today! From one woman’s excruciating pain “down there” to a pill-free fix for erectile dysfunction, The Doctors answers your most embarrassing questions! Could you leak breastmilk years after childbirth? The most embarrassing questions come out of our “Medical Confessional”! A celebrity stylist opens up about an embarrassing secret he’s kept under wraps for years! And, the athlete’s foot fix you can gargle with! Then, an unconventional way to relieve sinus pain that actually could work!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From diabetes-sniffing dogs, to prescription medicine vending machines to a killer fungus, get the latest health info, news and breakthroughs! And, learn how to keep your kids safe this Halloween.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It’s The Doctors’ Fans’ Favorites special - from the stories that broke your heart to the stories that broke the internet, we’re delivering ten years of our most memorable moments! A mother loses her hearing and spends fifteen years in silence until cochlear implant surgery. Our cameras were with her in the operating room and The unforgettable moment when she heard her son’s voice for the first time. See how they’re doing now! Remember the 685-pound teen with the voice of angel? Find out if he’s lost weight! Don’t miss the biggest transformations and the most-watched clip in The Doctors history!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Reality TV Star Wants A New Butt
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, Teen Mom OG star Farrah Abraham stops by for a consultation for butt implants! Then, we meet a New York City man who recently made press for being a free sperm donor with 22 children and counting! And, a weight loss plan based on your poop, does it work?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, Maureen McCormick reveals new details of her shocking past! Then, one woman undergoes a live procedure for her resting “angry” face, did it work? Plus, what you need to know to protect your child from the super lice outbreak and a child abductor!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Improve Your Health From A to Z
programme.desc: Get simple solutions for hiccups, nosebleeds, vertigo and 23 other ailments with The Doctors ABCs of medicine! Plus, learn how to how to last longer in bed. And, the number one mistake parents make when their kids get sick.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Exclusive: A woman famous for her 70-inch booty visits The Doctors! Is she in for a shocking diagnosis? Then, are you upping your family’s fire risk without even knowing it? We reveal three dangerous household items! Plus, a woman desperate to walk again turns to The Doctors for help!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: You won’t believe what happens when the show’s cameras go “Inside The O.R.” as a 51-year-old woman has a large fibroid removed, which left her looking 5 months pregnant! Controversial new study claims smart women should marry down if They want to start a family. E-cigarettes and vaping have been sold as a way for smokers to quit – new research on why it doesn’t work? The Doctors’ Court: woman arrested with five different types of drugs hidden…in her vagina?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: During the holidays, the average American consumes 619 extra calories daily! Fitness guru Jillian Michaels joins "The Doctors" to offer tips to keep your family’s figures slim and svelte while celebrating the season!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Decipher the clues and warning signs your body is giving you. Witness a life-saving surgery that a mother and daughter underwent together! Plus, learn what kind of bruises can indicate a serious medical condition.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Breast Implants Made Me Sick
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, a former Playboy Playmate claims her implants made her sick and says she’s not the only one! Derek Hough reveals how he stays fit and gives the inside scoop on his new show! Find out why some parents are potty training their kids … in public! A young man with a family history of early-onset Alzheimer’s turns to The Doctors! What will be revealed? Get the warning signs you need to know! Plus, a hoarder finally finds freedom … how did she do it?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: Snowfall, family fun and holiday cheer make winter the most wonderful time of the year. Learn how to winterize your home, keep your little ones warm and protect your skin from the elements!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: See the unbelievable recovery of a woman who was diagnosed with a rare and aggressive brain stroke. Did her family’s love turn around her dire prognosis? Do big feet mean big love in the bedroom? And, why are some farts squeaky and others silent? Then, the controversial plan one ER doctor has to combat the opioid epidemic. Could her “Death Diaries” save lives? The best foods for a better brain. And, the perfect bed time story to get you sleeping faster.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Are you your own worst critic? From sweaty armpits to thick ankles, see new solutions for your most “embarrassing” body problems. And, get simple, at-home remedies for brittle nails.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, Teen Mom OG stars Catelynn and Tyler Baltierra open up about Catelynn’s treatment for postpartum depression and the recent tabloid divorce rumors! Plus, he went from bullied to buff, and now one of your favorite guests returns to show off his skin removal! See the surgery closer than ever… from a Go-Pro camera on the surgeon’s head! And, one teen’s amazing transformation after a surgery to straighten the 180-degree angle in his head and neck!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors counts down the top five health scares. Learn when a headache can lead to a deadly stroke. And, 15 percent of pregnancies end in miscarriage. Dr. Lisa shares ways to prevent the heartbreaking loss.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A young man proposes in the ER in his hospital gown and the moment goes completely viral! Now, in a The Doctors exclusive, The couple shares their story, from what nearly took his life to the moment she said yes … and they’re in for a big surprise! A runner fights off a brutal attack with self-defense! Hear her remarkable story and safety tips for you! A woman endures years of teasing for her tiny teeth; can they be fixed? Then, what if your drinking water was hot pink? Would you drink it? One town recently dealt with this issue! A new study confirms how much urine is in the average pool! What you need to know before your next swim! The guide to being a “fab mom”! Plus, the fridge mistakes spoiling your food fast!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: World-renowned sex specialist, Dr. Ruth Westheimer, joins The Doctors to tackle your most outrageous and embarrassing questions yet. And, a solution for female urinary incontinence.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A celebrity hairstylist that’s groomed some of the hottest men in Hollywood changes the lives of homeless people with a haircut! The Doctors first wedding for a couple whose story went viral! What’s The Real Deal with a wearable device that relieves headaches? Does it work? Infant sleeping dangers every parent must hear! Simple trick for a perfect burger!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: When it comes to your health, being honest with your doctor is vital to maintaining your wellbeing. Whether it’s a nagging pain or your family’s medical history, find out all the information you must tell your physician.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Between Thanksgiving feasts and New Year’s treats, do you blame your bulge on holiday indulgences? Not so fast! THE DOCTORS reveals five reasons why it’s not the food that’s making you fat. What’s in your medicine cabinet? Painkillers and prescriptions can cause you to pack on pounds. Find out why. Sleep yourself thin. See how catching your ZZZs can whittle your waistline. | Are your workouts getting you nowhere? Get the skinny on your fitness routine, and how to bust through your weight loss plateau. Learn why liposuction can make you look larger. | Plus, happy hour diet tips, health food myths and more!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Nose Was Destroying My Life
programme.desc: A woman left deformed and devastated by a medical condition gets a new nose and a new lease on life! The Doctors debates a new ADHD medication for kids that tastes like candy! Can Botox be addictive? Find out! Plus, go inside the mind of a serial killer with a woman who was obsessed with one for years! The Doctors breaks down how many cups of coffee to drink to reduce your risk of Alzheimer’s. Is hitting the gym on the weekend enough to make a difference? Hear what science has to say!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: An alarming number of children are developing food allergies. Is your child one of them? Learn how to recognize symptoms and what treatments can keep your child safe. Is the fastest way to lose weight … eating more cookies? See if the controversial Cookie Diet is right for you! Find out what every woman needs to know about menopause, including the latest treatments to make the transition easier than ever! Do organs have memories? Learn about the fascinating research conducted on organ transplants and cellular memory.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A woman suspects she has thyroid cancer after an episode of The Doctors. Did she catch it in time? Haylie Duff dishes up family-friendly recipes that are good for you! A woman accuses a sex toy company of spying on her! The latest drug danger facing your teen could be found in the gardening store? Plus, could a vodka protect your liver?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: A month into the new year, and if you’ve gotten off track with your resolutions, don’t worry. Editor-in-chief of Prevention, Liz Vaccariello, joins The Doctors with simple ways to revitalize your will power.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Parents of TV star Cameron Boyce raise awareness about the medical condition that took their son’s life. A woman caused an emergency flight landing after she faked a medical emergency – to get a bigger seat! Would you pay a matchmaker to help you make friends? Could The secret to the perfect orthotics be 3D printing? Bride lets social media strangers create her wedding! Three snacks that will help ease muscle cramps!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Which side of the family tree is to blame for balding? One of America's most famous bald men, Dr. Phil, makes a surprise appearance to help settle the argument once and for all. And, the hairiest manscaping project yet!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Investigation into home food sensitivity tests – are they legit or a waste of a time and money? Shocking story of mom’s debilitating stimulant addiction! Class action lawsuit over vitamin shots? The craziest things dogs have eaten in “My Dog Ate What?”

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: I am a Munchausen by Proxy victim! Woman breaks her silence on medical abuse after several medical records and Doctors suggest her own mother intentionally kept her sick! Could the allegations be true? Win big prizes with The Word of The Day Giveaway!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: THE DOCTORS discusses a global STI on the rise … how worried should you be? Woman has tongue reconstructed using muscle from her thigh! Heather and Terry Dubrow share their new diet book! THE DOCTORS tests a scanner that detects how bad you stink! Who gets more allowance, boys or girls? Find out how you could be adding to a gender pay gap for kids! Fitness expert Stephanie Mansour demonstrates at-home exercises on your couch. How does your bedtime affect your sex life? Find out how pumpkins can benefit your health this Halloween season!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A family fed up with their mother’s years of alcohol abuse turns to THE DOCTORS for help! Will she finally quit her drinking and accept that she needs to go to rehab? Plus, elementary school drop-off lines are stressful, but why would a mom pull a gun on another mom? programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle] (2025)
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle] (2025)
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E03 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: The Reds and Blues discover some compelling information. Carolina faces past demons while Church sort of rides shotgun. While Carolina attempts to retrieve some additional A.I., the Reds and Blues return home.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 1)
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 2)
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Guess Who's Not Going To The Luau
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Prize In Each And Every Package
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Day In The Life Of Oliver Wendell Holmes
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Lisa's Mudder Comes For A Visit
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You And Your Big Shrunken Head
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: The Case Of The Hooterville Refund Fraud
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

programme.title: Eye Of The Needle (2023)
programme.desc: Donald Sutherland stars in this moody thriller as a villainous Nazi spy whose passions betray him via a married woman (Kate Nelligan) in this intriguing blend of romance and espionage against the backdrop of WWII Britain.

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery (2023)
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

programme.title: Over The Top (1987)
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: Missing In Action (2023)
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning (2023)
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III (2023)
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Red Dawn (2025)
programme.desc: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

programme.title: Navy Seals (1990)
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: No Man's Land (1987) (2023)
programme.desc: When a rookie cop goes undercover at a Porsche garage doubling as a chop shop, the fast cars and wild parties have him thinking that his suspect has the life he wants. But there may be more going on than just car theft...and he may be in too deep!

programme.title: Fled (1996)
programme.desc: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

programme.title: Hoodlum (2023)
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Mulholland Falls (2026)
programme.desc: In the 1950s, an elite squad of detectives becomes embroiled in a conspiracy and faces a secret the U.S. government is determined to keep hidden.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit."

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A robot probe destined for Mars is in jeopardy when the disembodied brain meant to control it discovers that it now has the ability to control...or to destroy. Grant Williams, Elizabeth Perry, Anthony Eisley, Douglas Kennedy and Peter Hansen star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A downed fighter pilot (Dewey Martin) and his wife (Mary Murphy) find themselves stuck in a different dimension where time is frozen whilst life in the real world travels on...towards a tragedy they want desperately to avert.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a cargo plane carrying five passengers is downed in the eye of a hurricane, the passengers find themselves trapped in an eerily cavernous chamber and dependent upon the "human" compassion of their alien captors for survival. Mark Richman stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Invitation To A Gunfighter (2023)
programme.desc: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba (1970)
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: The Hills Run Red (2023)
programme.desc: A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

programme.title: Death Rides A Horse (1969)
programme.desc: Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

programme.title: Navajo Joe (1967)
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: The Mercenary (1970)
programme.desc: Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite (1972)
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: The Way West (2025)
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks (2023)
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe (2023)
programme.desc: Jack (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil (Sam Waterston) are an oddball team of modern-day Montana cattle rustlers, and they've set their sights on a pair of unlikely ranch owners from New York (Clifton James, Elizabeth Ashley). But can they outfox the foxes?

programme.title: The Gunfight At Dodge City (1959)
programme.desc: Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

programme.title: Cast A Long Shadow (2026)
programme.desc: Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 1
programme.desc: Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 2
programme.desc: Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 3
programme.desc: Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 4
programme.desc: Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 5
programme.desc: Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 6
programme.desc: Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 7
programme.desc: The Rogue dies mysteriously in prison, leaving Hoon with the words "Fox Guard." Hoon and Joon search for the killer. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong reunites with her brother Kang, raising Ji Hwa's suspicions.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 8
programme.desc: Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 9
programme.desc: Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 10
programme.desc: Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 11
programme.desc: Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 12
programme.desc: Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 13
programme.desc: Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 14
programme.desc: Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 15
programme.desc: Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 16
programme.desc: The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.

He soon found himself at a Hollywood party with Jordan Peele, leading to his break out role in Get Out. From there his career has skyrocketed and his focus is on creating opportunities for his community to grow within the industry in this phase two of life.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de Rita, pero él no piensa repetir el error de dejar ir a su gran amor: está decidido a luchar por ella. Rita responde igual de firme: no renunciará a Piotr por sus padres. Mientras crece el escándalo de las casas estatales, Edik, colega de Piotr, descubre que intervienen su teléfono, vinculado a la élite política. La amenaza se vuelve real cuando dos desconocidos irrumpen en la redacción exigiendo el expediente, o la familia de Piotr pagará el precio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Por seguridad, Pyotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres, y logra una tregua temporal con Ksenia. Pero cuando entrega su artículo para la próxima edición, órdenes "desde arriba" retiran toda la tirada acusándolo de difamación. Dmitri, sin renunciar a separar a la pareja, se reúne con Aleksandr, el exnovio de Rita e instructor del centro náutico, y le da su bendición para reconquistarla... con una condición: deshacerse de Pyotr.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia se aman desde hace años y sueñan con formar una familia justo cuando terminan sus estudios. Pero el padre de Ksenia, dueño de una constructora, es acusado de lavado de dinero a gran escala y podría perderlo todo, incluida su libertad. Entonces aparece Grigory Dmitrievich, un viejo conocido de la familia con poder en la administración local, dispuesto a salvarlo... a cambio de una sola condición: que Ksenia se case con su hijo Dima, un joven que estudia pintura.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Veinte años después, la familia del artista Dmitri llega a una ciudad costera de vacaciones con Ksenia y su hija Rita. Al recibir una invitación a la reunión escolar, Ksenia no puede negarse: en el fondo, muere por ver de nuevo a Piotr. Pero es Rita, de 19, quien se cruza primero con él, rescatada por Piotr de un peligro. Ahora periodista y editor respetado, con una historia explosiva sobre corrupción en antiguas propiedades del partido, Piotr empieza a sentir atracción por la joven.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Moscú, 1978. Sasha, una huérfana ingenua criada en un internado de provincias, llega a la capital recién cumplidos los 18 años, dispuesta a empezar su vida adulta. Consigue trabajo como limpiadora en la Casa de la Moda... y de ahí pasa a convertirse en una modelo célebre. Tres hombres muy distintos empiezan a cortejarla: el artista de vanguardia Iván, el bien relacionado Vadim y el mayor del KGB Kim. Pero Sasha ya eligió al hombre de sus sueños, y estar junto a él le costará pruebas increíbles.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Sasha e Iván son felices, sin sospechar que han despertado el interés de Kim Olegovich, mayor de la KGB y supervisor de la Casa de Modelos, decidido a separarlos. Atraído por Sasha, Kim recurre al chantaje y la manipulación para acercarse a ella, y la relación de la pareja empieza a desmoronarse. Justo cuando está a punto de lograr su objetivo, le llega una noticia que lo sacude a él... y a toda la Casa de Modelos: Sasha se va a casar.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: La vida de Sasha con un esposo al que no ama se vuelve insoportable. Pero en su camino hacia la felicidad con Iván aún se interpone Kim Olegovich. Atrapados y sin salida, los amantes toman una decisión desesperada…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…
